notes.title: Update 1.1!
notes.notes:
I am Neutron is getting its first major update! There's now enemies and rooms and fighting (kind of, sort of). Try it out. Full changes below.

New Additions

 Added an enemy, it can
 Collide with you
 Deal damage
 Saved sound settings
 Added health bar
 Added a “form” of “dying”
 Camera now follows player
 Restart button and function
 “Room” Shapes
 Random rooms
 Somewhat random enemies
 Added “Doors”


Bug Fixes

 Achievements now work (Probably)
 Nerfed permaspike
 Removed Herobrine
